normalized.result: That's exactly right. I selected the first two cards, hit "Put away" on the action bar, and they left the main library in one go — only the one card I hadn't picked stayed behind. Then over in the Put away area both of the ones I'd set aside were sitting there whole and unchanged, ready to restore. So the bulk put-away behaves just like doing it card by card, only faster, and nothing gets destroyed. That settles the batch put-away for me.
